text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: 『Power』. The ultimate Joker in any hand.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: However, that holds true only when one transcends mere logic and theory. Wielding half-baked power makes you nothing more than a clown.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: And thus――

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Can you not even endure a gentle warm-up? Your pace is already flagging.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Did you not design this routine yourself? With your own hands, this very menu.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: 『A commendable display of spirit indeed.』
choice_data_list: 『I swear it on my trainer badge!』
『I swear it on my trainer badge!』

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: 『……If so, why not demonstrate what you are truly capable of?』

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Or was all of this merely a shallow farce to prove how 『Serious』 you were?
Hearing her sharp remark, I shook my head while forcing my trembling muscles to push on. No, this was――
This was a training regimen I had built for myself as though I were an Uma Musume in training. ……Adjusted, of course, to baseline human parameters.
choice_data_list: This is so I can stand beside you!
This is so I can stand beside you!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Heh……I see.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: If that is the case, then this is nowhere near sufficient, you know.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Sticking to standard, pedestrian workouts will only turn you into a muscular clown.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: If you truly desire to hold the ultimate Joker, you must cast aside all comfortable logic and reasoning.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Fear not. I shall teach you how to strip away such trivial notions. Step by step, from here on out……understood?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: First――squats. We shall refine your posture. Your core balance and weight distribution—those shall become the very foundation of your power.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Why are you dawdling? Assume the stance immediately.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Place your feet shoulder-width apart and slowly drop your hips. Keep your torso upright, and do not allow your knees to track past your toes――

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Now hold that position for ten seconds. Merely ten seconds—a trivial task, is it not? Very well……ready, go!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: 1! 2! 3! 4! 5! 6! 7! 8! ……Your hips and chin are rising! Keep them down! ……8, 9, 10!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Next, moving directly into the second set. This time, should your posture falter, the count shall freeze.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Ready, go!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: You see? If you slacken your resolve, this will never conclude, you know?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Acceptable. Now then――one more set.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Very well, a three-minute rest.
The instant the word 『Rest』 left her lips, I collapsed flat onto the floor. Gasping for breath, I barely managed to reach for my water bottle.
(Beep beep beep beep!)
Three minutes vanished in an instant. My breathing was still ragged, and every muscle in my body begged me to stop――and yet.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: My, you can still stand?
choice_data_list: Not yet! I can keep going……!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ……Heh. …………Fufuu.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Well now, consider me genuinely intrigued. ……To think you still possessed such ample 『Leeway』.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Pray forgive my presumption. I have taken the full measure of your resolve.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Shall we proceed, then? ……This time, 『In earnest』.
――I have little recollection of what followed after that.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Stop stumbling about, it's unsightly.
You're like a newborn deer. I fear for the future.

Before I realized it, it was over and we were walking around
outside. But, now I just needed to make it back to the academy――

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Ara? That's……

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Fufuu……this profound glimmer. Such high quality that
can be seen even through this showcase. As expected――

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: A super high quality iron weight.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, 『Super Heavy class』 but still this
compact. Seems useful for carrying around too.

……there were many things I wanted to tsukkomi about.
There were, but more than that――
choice_data_list: Y-you're going to carry that around……?
Y-you're going to carry that around……?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Like a walking dumbbell.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. It's quite good.
Besides――

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It has a 『Carrying Case』.
So there are great merits to choosing this one.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ……Look. It's wrapped in lace, so it's quite cute.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If you want to increase the weight even further,
there are even these weighted charms. Fufuu.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
……Ara?
This leather case, I wonder if it's a new color.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm……Hey. Could you take out this item?
Yes. That brand new one.

It was a shocking difference from her previously
Spartan attitude……though, it made sense, I guess.

If you carried around your own muscle training goods,
it might make it more fun to work out.

Thinking that, I tried reaching my hand out to the
『Super Heavy Class Iron Weight』 that had caught her eye but……

Heavy, it was too heavy……! It wasn't realistic
at all for me to carry around something like this.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Ara……Ho ho ho.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: It's way too early for you to use that, rookie-san.

But someday I'll be able to take it.
While vowing that, I purchased my own, lighter one.
